regional_support.orientation: Source describes Track020 as almost perpendicular to the Agulhas Current; no exact flow-normal correction supplied.
regional_support.feature: Dynamical core; not the full extent of southwestward flow

records.label: Along-track altimetry Gaussian core
records.reported_precision: Integer kilometres as printed; no rounding allowance inferred
records.operator: Gaussian fit to local southward across-track geostrophic velocity maximum, with shoreward and seaward edges described as plus/minus one fitted standard deviation.
records.dataset: AVISO GDR along-track Topex and Jason1/2 absolute geostrophic velocity,1Hz,nominal5.8km; Lee-filtered ADT and velocity
records.source_time_description: 18-year altimetry record; overall variability study described as1992-2011
records.source_locator: Section3 paragraph5, PDF page2, right column; method Section2 paragraph4, PDF pages1-2

records.label: Sea-surface-temperature core
records.reported_precision: Integer kilometres as printed; no rounding allowance inferred
records.operator: Local SST maximum bounded by neighboring SST minima, using five-day exponentially weighted SEVIRI SST maps extracted within a15km bandwidth along Track020.
records.dataset: Hourly SEVIRI SST on0.05degree grid, CERSAT product; five-day averages
records.source_time_description: Close to seven years of high-frequency SST; exact width-mean estimation bounds unspecified
records.source_locator: Section3 paragraph5, PDF page2, right column; method Section2 paragraph4, PDF page2, left column

source_ambiguities.locator: Section2 paragraph4, PDF page1 final lines, continuing on page2
source_ambiguities.source_issue: The text describes the Gaussian-core edges both as plus/minus one fitted standard deviation and as a half-maximum region. These descriptions are not mathematically equivalent for a standard Gaussian.
source_ambiguities.handling: Retain the published64km mean and both descriptions. Do not silently convert to FWHM, infer an exact velocity cutoff, or rerun a corrected estimator.

seasonality_finding.claim: The authors did not detect annual variations in dynamical-core width in their along-track altimetry and SST analyses.
seasonality_finding.locator: Section3 paragraph5, PDF page3 final lines; Section5 paragraph10, PDF page5; abstract PDF page1
seasonality_finding.context: Rapid width changes and irregular offshore meanders are described. The seasonal cycle detected in core velocity is a different quantity.
